frameworks.author: Crisp2002

v1.name: Custom Missions v1
v1.installTo: game folder (unpack the archive into the root)
v1.missionFiles: Usually .json files, placed directly in CustomMissions.

v2.name: Custom Missions v2
v2.installTo: game folder (unpack the archive into the root)
v2.missionFiles: Folders with .code files. Each pack keeps its own folder: CustomMissions2/<Pack>/<Mission>.code, never CustomMissions2/<Mission>.code.

notes: v1 and v2 can be installed at the same time.
CustomMissions and CustomMissions2 ship with example missions that can be deleted.
Some missions require other missions; read each linked post.

type.mixed: Plugins and missions in one download
type.tool: Tool for players or mission authors

legend.authors: authorsRaw is the list's 'Original + Modder(s)' text; originalAuthors and modders split it, authors is both. '[Authors]' and '[Unknown]' placeholders are left out.
legend.name: null when the list gives no name; nameHint then holds the list's description, e.g. 'no name, 3 step mission'. nameZh is the title from the Simplified Chinese section.
legend.obsolete: Shown in gray in the list: kept for history, usually replaced by a newer entry.
legend.relatedPosts: Post numbers mentioned in the name or note (replacements, patches, requirements); relatedLinks are the ones the list links to.
legend.key: Stable id: the post or thread plus the name, unique in this file.

sections.name: Persistent missions
sections.description: Vanilla-like missions that are repeatable or endless and ask for things to be done under specific conditions or in a specific place. They usually don't interfere with other persistent or story missions.

sections.name: Story missions
sections.description: Step-by-step missions with a scripted set of quests to progress through. They may or may not have an actual story.

sections.name: Mini-games/Modes
sections.description: Missions that bend the core gameplay into something new, usually with new gameplay loops, systems or challenges.

sections.name: Gameplay utility
sections.description: Missions that add minor mechanical or quality-of-life changes to the base game.

sections.name: Addons and Player utility
sections.description: Missions that add major changes outside of the core game or alter other mods.

sections.name: Developer tools
sections.description: Material for people who create their own missions.

sections.name: Simplified Chinese
sections.description: Anything translated to Simplified Chinese. Accuracy is not guaranteed.
